page.layout: One leaf, title-page area, only faint show-through and a blue-grey device, with a narrow strip of the neighbouring page at the right edge.
page.notes: No printed text on this leaf can be transcribed as its own text. The inverted, mirrored lines at the top and centre (the upside-down title lines, "REFORMATORUM", "INTERPRETES SCRIPTURAE", the lines beneath, and the imprint at the foot) are show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. The faint blue-grey circular device in the centre looks like show-through of a woodcut from the reverse, so it is not transcribed either. Some stamp-like marks at the lower left are also excluded as library marks. The strip at the right edge (the running "PR", "LE C" and the column of text) belongs to the neighbouring page and is excluded. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. If the leaf carries a genuine title that is hidden by show-through, it would need a rescan with better light or the verso to confirm.
